rongmei.title: Rei khou mousi rui kanan ram njuan

lines: 1. Rei khou Mousi rui kanan ram njuan,
Nduang ngam mak Raguang lat 1@: phunga;
Kanan ram gundaimei le gaimei 1@: hou,
Lumma ninga kap ni maknga cho?
Chorus:
He ai rui kanan ramgai mei 1@:,
Apumtan rui guang lungtang ngammak;
Reikhou guang Jehovah rui jailou na,
Kanan ram gaimei guai 1@: hou puni.
2. Kanan riu 1@: tingthan patmei kum e,
Jailou Mousi rui guang khang nduanga;
Jordan duipang thang1@: bamlou dumaknga,
Njianmei nun ta jai pat lou the.
3. Lungning gaimei ram ta 1@: ning lana,
Guang ram gaimei tingsanga gaipui ram;
Khou1@: guangmei kankhou ramgaimei lungkhou,
Kapumma mun kumma puang louni.
4. Kanan munpuang le ram bam gaimei khou,
Jailou Mousi rui thei nganna lung khang;
Lumloumei nun Salem than ta thuan ku the,
Israel nun ni lumlou dat the.
